guesses.reason: Small sturdy body, short muzzle with a black nose, round dark eyes, a long wavy white coat with tan ear patches, and a tail curled over the back are all classic Shih Tzu traits.
The slightly longer muzzle, bearded face, and dense, slightly coarse coat curling up over the back suggest Lhasa Apso influence.
The mostly white, soft, wavy coat and small toy-sized frame point to possible Maltese ancestry.

breed.appearance: A small, compact dog with a shaggy, wavy, mostly white coat, tan/apricot shading on the drooping feathered ears, and a light tan tinge along the back and on the plumed tail curled over the back. It has round, dark brown-black eyes, a short muzzle with a black button nose, and a scruffy tan-stained beard and mustache around the mouth. It is shown looking up eagerly, wearing a thin orange slip leash.
breed.fun_fact: Shih Tzus were bred as cherished companions for Chinese royalty, so this little lion dog was born to be a lap-warming best friend!
